Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 1, Verse 45

“Alas, we are resolved to commit a great sin, in that out of greed for the pleasures of a kingdom we are prepared to kill our own people.”

The self-accusation is total, and he includes himself in it. Nothing in the verse acknowledges that the Kauravas began this war — in his despair Arjuna has taken on the whole guilt.
